purpose: Compose the existing HTTP/core/GroundedReasoner/MetisGroundedPlanner/MetisReasoner/ledger and complete review handoff without any real provider request.

inherited_exact_output_oracle.reviewer_kind: assistant source inspection; no human gold

execution_boundary.http_transport: httpx.MockTransport mandatory; no real HTTP transport
execution_boundary.credential: public synthetic fixture string, never environment
execution_boundary.ledger: new TemporaryDirectory SQLite only; original ledger is never opened
execution_boundary.provider_response: developer-authored GroundedPlan over the actual emitted provider JSON request

registered_controls.known_inputs: The same first-turn reported facts, unknown version, complete fixed five-hit pool and canonical question catalog.
registered_controls.missing_information: Installed version is user-clarifiable; full-app cause/fix requires further source/application investigation.
registered_controls.provider_behavior: First paid mock completion contains malformed plan JSON despite known usage; second completion chooses the registered version question.
registered_controls.acceptable_decision: ask after exactly one repair, retaining the entire independently reviewed first-turn analysis

registered_controls.known_inputs: Same first-turn case and supplied sources; valid raw plan and fake known usage but unverified serving model identity.
registered_controls.missing_information: Provider identity/pricing is unverified; the user cannot clarify this with an application version reply.
registered_controls.provider_behavior: Return gpt-4.1-mini for a gpt-4o-mini request.
registered_controls.acceptable_decision: terminal ProviderModelMismatch, no proposal, no second HTTP request; uncertainty retained and temporary ledger halted

registered_controls.known_inputs: Same first-turn case and supplied sources; reservation succeeds but mock transport times out.
registered_controls.missing_information: Whether the provider processed the request and what usage occurred remain unknown.
registered_controls.provider_behavior: Raise httpx.ReadTimeout once; no automatic resend.
registered_controls.acceptable_decision: terminal ProviderRequestFailed, no proposal, uncertain reservation retained; no second HTTP request

recording_rules: Record provider JSON payloads and caller-owned contexts, never HTTP headers or Authorization.
Verify an actual reservation exists before MockTransport receives the request.
Request IDs are real request_id_for(context) values; mode/repair/catalog do not bypass duplicate protection.
Record simulated usage/settlement separately from actual paid requests/cost, both zero.
Whole final outputs match the inherited frozen posthoc C3 oracle; source metadata/catalog freshness and event replay use the unchanged C3 assertions.
Any source/code change during execution or disabled assertions prevents a success receipt.
Existing receipts must not be overwritten.
limitations: Provider responses are authored; no actual model choice or provider compatibility is measured.
Fake retrieval uses exposed answer-informed development evidence, not real RAG or final-test data.
Temporary ledger bookkeeping is not team-account billing reconciliation.
C3 memory tracker remains unauthenticated and cannot establish durable restart/action behavior.
Conflict routing remains an explicit synthetic caller-declared control, not a discovered contradiction.
